name: 星界航行
spec: 星图轨道与天文观测仪；靛蓝 #10162D、冷青 #78DCE8、紫 #9D88D5；蚀刻钛金属和低反射光学玻璃，侧向冷光；细线圆弧图标，精密无衬线标题；轨道缺口卡框、圆形费用标记；选中青色实线与光点，停用去饱和，错误珊瑚红。
direction: STARFARER: precision astrolabe UI in an immense deep-indigo observatory overlooking a luminous nebula. Cold cyan focal lighting with restrained violet, titanium etched with orbital arcs and low-glare optical glass. Invent an asymmetric radial/arc navigation constellation around an off-center armillary sphere; actual label plaques stay horizontal and readable, not a generic five-row sidebar. Brand in upper-left negative space, utilities on a stable top rail. Main battle destination larger; creation destinations form a smaller lower dock. Thin orbital glyphs, calibrated geometric sans typography, economical glows. Card frame uses notched titanium with cyan orbital cost ring. The atmosphere is mysterious astronomical exploration, not military machinery.

Rich environment depth above the navigation, generous calm spacing. Chinese headings with elegant Song-style serif character and clean UI body type. spec: 星象目录、藏品编号与压印章；骨白 #E8E2D5、墨黑 #26252A、铜 #A76F47、酒红 #743340；棉纸、压印与拉丝铜，温和展陈侧光；宋体编辑式标题与黑体控件；纸质嵌铜卡框、圆形索引费用；选中酒红底与铜线，停用低对比灰，错误深红加明确标记。
direction: ASTRAL ARCHIVE: a luminous fantasy collection gallery rather than an office app. Bone-white tactile cotton paper, ink-black typography, copper embossing, wine-red selection, fine star-chart lines, warm museum side-light.
